findings.comment: Zoning ordinance numbers not referenced on cover sheet. The cover sheet shows Zoning Case No. C14-2013-0093 and Zoning MF-2 but does not display the actual applicable zoning ordinance numbers (such as Ordinance No. 20120112-092). Both the zoning case number AND the ordinance numbers must be shown.

Zoning conditions or restrictions not listed on cover sheet. The property is subject to Residential Design Standards (Subchapter F) compatibility standards triggered by the adjacent SF-3 parcel to the south, which limit structures within 25 feet of the SF-3 lot line to a maximum of 2 stories and 30 feet in height. These zoning conditions must be noted on the cover sheet.

applicableAreas: Cover sheet - Site Development Data table
findings.comment: Surveyor's company name, address, and telephone number not shown on cover sheet. The Surveyor role is entirely missing from the Site Development Data table. The surveyor's firm name, contact address, and phone number must be added to the table.

Required legal instruments not listed on cover sheet. A consolidated 'Legal Instruments' section listing all easements, restrictive covenants, maintenance agreements, and other legal encumbrances affecting the property is missing. The property is encumbered by recorded easements including a Greenbelt Access & Use Easement (Instrument 2010070731) and a City of Austin Drainage Easement (Instrument 2011021137), among others, which must be documented on the cover sheet.

Maintenance agreement document number not referenced on cover sheet. The cover sheet states 'The proposed stacked biofiltration/detention pond will be privately maintained' but does not provide a recorded maintenance agreement document number or a placeholder for one. For a multi-family development with a water quality detention/biofiltration pond, a formal maintenance agreement referenced by recorded document number is required. Include a note in the format: 'Maintenance Agreement for [Facility Name] filed in document No. ________, Official Public Records, Travis County, Texas' with a blank placeholder if not yet recorded.
